line.en: Yesterday (Nov 23) ETH and BTC broke hard through the mapped ceiling without coming back (both runs' A+ sell stayed broken on both coins) with ETH open interest climbing hard; the automatic bias hit on the close (+82.95 points ETH, +2,267.31 BTC) but missed on the ny when the mid-afternoon shock cut the extension short (-63.71 ETH, -1,495.28 BTC). Text predictions 0/8: the four cited ceilings broke on 15-minute closes and the four ranges too, first to the downside overnight and then to the upside in the afternoon, same pattern on both coins. Zones 2/8 touched-and-won: on the close both A+ sells broke without reclaiming and both B continuation buys stopped out; on the ny both A+ sells broke again but both B continuation buys did work this time (r 0.26 ETH, r 0.21 BTC).
